text: Issue: User forgot laptop password and is locked out. Resolution: Verify user identity, initiate a remote password reset via Active Directory, and confirm the user can log in via VPN.
Issue: Outlook stuck in 'Processing' or 'Trying to connect' mode. Resolution: Close Outlook, run 'outlook.exe /safe', disable hardware graphics acceleration, and rebuild the OST file if necessary.

Issue: GlobalProtect VPN failing to connect with 'Portal not found' error. Resolution: Check internet connectivity, flush DNS cache using 'ipconfig /flushdns', and ensure the portal URL is set to vpn.company.com.

Issue: Network printer shows 'Offline' status for all users. Resolution: Restart the print spooler service on the print server, verify the printer's IP address, and check for a paper jam or empty toner.
Issue: Zoom audio is not working during a call. Resolution: Direct the user to 'Settings > Audio' to select the correct output device and ensure the microphone is not muted at the system level.
Issue: Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) with error 'Inaccessible Boot Device'. Resolution: Restart in BIOS, ensure the SATA mode is set to AHCI, and run 'chkdsk /f' from the recovery command prompt.
Issue: User cannot access the shared department drive (S: Drive). Resolution: Check if the user is in the correct AD Group for 'Dept_Access', and remap the drive using the UNC path \\server\share.
Issue: Battery draining rapidly on a MacBook Pro. Resolution: Check 'Activity Monitor' for high-CPU processes, reset the SMC (System Management Controller), and recalibrate the battery cycles.
Issue: Excel crashes when opening large CSV files. Resolution: Disable 'COM Add-ins', increase virtual memory allocation in Windows, and suggest using Power Query to import the data instead.
Issue: ServiceNow 'My Requests' page is not loading. Resolution: Clear browser cache and cookies, ensure the user has the 'itil' or 'snc_internal' role, and check for any active HI platform outages.
Issue: Laptop fan making loud grinding noise. Resolution: Shut down the device, inspect for dust/debris, and replace the thermal cooling fan if the noise persists after cleaning.

Issue: Microsoft Teams status stuck on 'In a call' after meeting ends. Resolution: Force quit Microsoft Teams via Task Manager, clear the %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams folder, and restart the application.

Issue: User unable to view PDF attachments in Chrome. Resolution: Update Chrome to the latest version and ensure 'Download PDF files instead of automatically opening them' is disabled in Site Settings.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Submit' button is greyed out on the Incident form. Resolution: Ensure all mandatory fields (Short Description, Caller, Category) are filled and check for any UI Policy conflicts.
Issue: External monitor flickering when connected to docking station. Resolution: Replace the DisplayPort/HDMI cable, update the dock firmware, and ensure the laptop power supply is at least 65W.
Issue: Adobe Acrobat asking for sign-in repeatedly. Resolution: Sign out of all Adobe apps, delete the 'OOBE' folder in Local AppData, and sign back in using Enterprise SSO credentials.

Issue: User profile taking 5+ minutes to load on Windows 11. Resolution: Investigate Group Policy Objects (GPOs), check for large Desktop/Documents folders, and recreate the local user profile if corrupt.
Issue: iPhone not syncing corporate email via Intune/Outlook. Resolution: Remove the device from the Company Portal app, delete the management profile, and re-enroll the device.
Issue: Wi-Fi shows 'No Internet, Secured' on a Windows laptop. Resolution: Right-click the Wi-Fi icon, select 'Troubleshoot,' then run 'netsh int ip reset' in an Admin Command Prompt.
Issue: Excel 'Power Pivot' tab missing from the ribbon. Resolution: Go to File > Options > Add-ins, select 'COM Add-ins' from the dropdown, and check the 'Microsoft Power Pivot for Excel' box.
Issue: ServiceNow Knowledge Base article not appearing in search. Resolution: Verify the article is in 'Published' state and ensure the 'Can Read' user criteria includes the logged-in user's role.
Issue: USB mouse and keyboard intermittently stop working. Resolution: Disable 'USB selective suspend' in Windows Power Options and check for BIOS updates related to USB controller stability.
Issue: OneDrive 'Processing changes' stuck for 24 hours. Resolution: Reset OneDrive by running 'onedrive.exe /reset' in the Run dialog and check for files with invalid characters like < > : " | ? *.
Issue: Blue Screen with 'WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR'. Resolution: Check for hardware overheating, run a stress test on the CPU, and revert any recent overclocking settings in BIOS.
Issue: Outlook calendar shows 'Working Elsewhere' incorrectly. Resolution: Open Outlook on the web (OWA), check the 'Work hours and location' settings, and sync the desktop client.
Issue: ServiceNow 'My Approvals' widget is empty for a manager. Resolution: Check if the manager is assigned as the 'Approver' on the sysapproval_approver table and verify the workflow state.
Issue: User cannot see the 'C:' drive in File Explorer. Resolution: Check 'Disk Management' to see if the drive letter was removed and verify if a GPO 'Hide these specified drives' is active.
Issue: Zoom meeting recording failed to convert. Resolution: Ensure there is at least 5GB of free disk space and manually run the 'zTscoder.exe' from the Zoom installation folder.
Issue: Printer printing 'garbage' text/symbols. Resolution: Uninstall the existing driver, download the specific 'PostScript' or 'PCL6' driver from the manufacturer, and clear the print queue.
Issue: BitLocker asking for recovery key every reboot. Resolution: Suspend BitLocker in Control Panel, update the BIOS/TPM firmware, and then resume BitLocker protection.
Issue: User cannot find 'Service Catalog' in ServiceNow mobile app. Resolution: Check the 'Applet Launcher' configuration and ensure the 'Catalog' tab is included in the navigation bar.
Issue: Slack notifications not appearing on macOS. Resolution: Go to System Settings > Notifications > Slack and ensure 'Allow Notifications' and 'Banners' are enabled.
Issue: Internal website shows 'Your connection is not private'. Resolution: Synchronize the system clock with the internet time server and check if the root CA certificate is installed.
Issue: Laptop keyboard typing wrong characters (e.g., @ instead of "). Resolution: Change the keyboard language layout from 'UK' to 'US' (or vice versa) in the Language bar settings.
Issue: ServiceNow 'List' view is missing columns for one user. Resolution: Click the gear icon (Personalize List), click 'Reset to Column Defaults,' and save the view.
Issue: VPN disconnects as soon as the user locks their screen. Resolution: Modify the VPN client settings to 'Keep connection alive' and check the power management settings of the Wi-Fi adapter.
Issue: Web browser 'Aw, Snap!' error on all pages. Resolution: Disable all extensions, clear browser cache, and check if third-party antivirus is intercepting HTTPS traffic.
Issue: 'Invalid Credentials' error on ServiceNow login. Resolution: Verify the user is active in the 'sys_user' table and check if their account is locked due to multiple failed attempts.
Issue: External hard drive 'Access Denied'. Resolution: Take ownership of the drive via the 'Security' tab in Properties and assign 'Full Control' to the 'Authenticated Users' group.
Issue: Micro-SD card not recognized in laptop slot. Resolution: Update the 'Realtek Card Reader' driver and check for physical damage to the adapter or the card itself.
Issue: Word 'Product Activation Failed' banner. Resolution: Run the 'Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant' (SaRA) tool to repair the Office license activation.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Choice List' values are missing. Resolution: Check if the 'Dependent Value' field is set and verify that the choices exist for the specific table and element.
Issue: Audio feedback/echo during conference calls. Resolution: Mute all participants except the speaker and suggest the user switch from speakers to a dedicated headset.
Issue: Windows Taskbar is frozen/unresponsive. Resolution: Restart 'Windows Explorer' (explorer.exe) via Task Manager and run 'sfc /scannow' to repair system files.
Issue: PDF text is blurry when printed. Resolution: Change the print setting to 'Print as Image' in the Acrobat print dialog and set the resolution to 600 DPI.
Issue: ServiceNow email notifications not sending. Resolution: Check the 'Email Diagnostics' page and verify that 'Email Sending' is enabled in the System Properties.
Issue: Desktop icons rearranged after every reboot. Resolution: Right-click desktop, select 'View,' and uncheck 'Auto arrange icons' and 'Align icons to grid'.
Issue: Scanner 'Communication Error' over the network. Resolution: Ping the scanner's IP address, ensure port 9100 is open, and restart the WIA (Windows Image Acquisition) service.
Issue: User's voice sounds like a 'Robot' on VoIP calls. Resolution: Check for high network latency (jitter), disable 'Background Noise Suppression' in the app, and test with a wired connection.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Business Rule' not triggering. Resolution: Check if 'Active' is checked and verify if 'setWorkflow(false)' is being called in other scripts affecting the same record.
Issue: Laptop screen remains black after waking from sleep. Resolution: Press 'Win + Ctrl + Shift + B' to reset the graphics driver and update the Intel/Nvidia display drivers.
Issue: Outlook 'Out of Office' reply not working for external users. Resolution: Check the Exchange 'Remote Domains' setting to ensure 'Auto-replies to external domains' is enabled.
Issue: Browser says 'Cookie too large' or '400 Bad Request'. Resolution: Clear the cookies specifically for that domain in the browser's 'Privacy and Security' settings.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Reference Field' shows SysID instead of Name. Resolution: Ensure the 'Display' checkbox is set to true for the 'Name' column on the referenced table.
Issue: ZIP file 'Compressed folder is invalid'. Resolution: Download the file again using a different browser and check for anti-malware software blocking the extraction.
Issue: Monitor shows 'Input Not Supported' message. Resolution: Boot into 'Safe Mode' and change the display resolution to a standard setting like 1920x1080 at 60Hz.
Issue: 'Too many redirects' error on ServiceNow portal. Resolution: Check the 'Redirect URL' in the Portal configuration and verify the user has the correct 'Single Sign-On' mapping.
Issue: Keypad numbers not working (typing arrows instead). Resolution: Press the 'Num Lock' key on the keyboard and check if 'Mouse Keys' is enabled in Ease of Access settings.
Issue: User accidentally deleted a folder in OneDrive. Resolution: Direct the user to the 'OneDrive Recycle Bin' on the web portal to restore the folder within 30 days.
Issue: Java application 'Class Not Found' error. Resolution: Verify the 'JAVA_HOME' environment variable is correctly set and the classpath includes the necessary JAR files.

Issue: ServiceNow 'ACL' preventing a user from editing a field. Resolution: Check the 'Security Debugger' to identify the failing ACL and verify if the user has the required roles or if the 'Admin overrides' is checked.

Issue: Laptop battery charging stops at 80%. Resolution: Check for 'Battery Health Management' settings in BIOS or the manufacturer's power utility and disable the 'Life Cycle' limit if full charge is required.

Issue: ServiceNow 'UI Action' not appearing on the form. Resolution: Verify the 'Condition' field of the UI Action, ensure the 'Form button' checkbox is true, and check if any Client Scripts are hiding it.

Issue: Error 'The trust relationship between this workstation and the primary domain failed'. Resolution: Unjoin the computer from the domain, delete the AD Computer Object, and re-join the device to the domain.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Workflow' stuck in a 'Published' state but not triggering. Resolution: Check the 'Workflow Properties' for the correct trigger conditions and ensure the 'Table' matches the record being created.
Issue: Microsoft Teams 'Camera not found' during a call. Resolution: Check 'Privacy & Security > Camera' settings in Windows to ensure 'Let desktop apps access your camera' is turned on.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Variable Set' not showing on a Service Portal item. Resolution: Check the 'Type' of the variable set and ensure 'Include on Task' or 'Show on Portal' is enabled for that specific catalog item.
Issue: Excel file is 'Locked for editing' by another user. Resolution: Ask the user to close the file, or check for a hidden 'owner file' (starting with ~$) in the directory and delete it.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Update Set' showing errors during preview. Resolution: Review the 'Missing Record' errors, ensure all dependencies are moved first, and use the 'Accept Remote Update' option only if safe.
Issue: User receives 'Access Denied' when accessing a SharePoint site. Resolution: Check the 'Site Permissions' levels and verify if the user is part of a M365 Group that has been granted access.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Transform Map' failing to import data. Resolution: Check the 'Import Set' logs for data type mismatches and ensure the 'Coalesce' field is correctly defined to prevent duplicates.
Issue: Windows 'Update' stuck at 0% for several hours. Resolution: Stop the 'Windows Update' service, rename the 'SoftwareDistribution' folder, and restart the service to force a fresh check.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Service Portal' page showing 404 error. Resolution: Verify the 'Page ID' in the URL matches a record in the 'sp_page' table and check if the page is restricted by 'User Criteria'.
Issue: Dual monitors detected but second screen is black. Resolution: Use 'Win + P' to select 'Extend', update the graphics driver, and check if the refresh rate is set to a supported frequency.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Scheduled Job' not running at the specified time. Resolution: Check the 'Next Action' field in the sys_trigger table and verify that the system time zone matches the job schedule.
Issue: SSH connection 'Connection Timed Out' to a Linux server. Resolution: Verify the server's Security Group allows traffic on Port 22 and check if the local IP is whitelisted in the firewall.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Business Rule' causing a recursive loop. Resolution: Add 'gr.setWorkflow(false)' before any 'gr.update()' calls within the script to prevent re-triggering the same rule.
Issue: Outlook 'Search' not showing recent emails. Resolution: Rebuild the 'Indexing Options' in Windows Control Panel and ensure 'Microsoft Outlook' is included in the locations to index.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Data Policy' preventing a record from saving via Import Set. Resolution: Check the 'Reverse if False' setting and ensure the incoming data meets the 'Mandatory' or 'Read Only' constraints.
Issue: Mac user cannot access a network drive via SMB. Resolution: Ensure the 'smb://' prefix is used in the 'Connect to Server' dialog and verify the user is using their domain credentials.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Client Script' not working in the Service Portal. Resolution: Change the 'UI Type' from 'Desktop' to 'All' or 'Mobile / Service Portal' within the script record.
Issue: 'Page File' error causing Windows to crash. Resolution: Manually set the 'Virtual Memory' size in System Properties to 1.5x the amount of physical RAM and restart.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Catalog Item' showing 'Item not found'. Resolution: Check if the 'Availability' field is set to 'Desktop and Mobile' and ensure the item is 'Active' and linked to a 'Category'.
Issue: Docker container 'Exit Code 137'. Resolution: This indicates an Out-of-Memory (OOM) error; increase the RAM limit for the container or optimize the application's memory usage.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Report' shows 'Security constraints' for certain rows. Resolution: Check the 'Read ACLs' for the specific table and ensure the user has the 'report_admin' or necessary functional roles.
Issue: Mouse cursor jumping randomly while typing on a laptop. Resolution: Disable the 'Tap to Click' feature in Touchpad settings or lower the touchpad sensitivity.
Issue: ServiceNow 'IntegrationHub' spoke failing with '401 Unauthorized'. Resolution: Refresh the OAuth token or verify the 'Credential' record in ServiceNow has the correct API Key.
Issue: 'NTLM' authentication prompts appearing in Edge. Resolution: Add the internal site URL to the 'Local Intranet' zone in Internet Options and enable 'Automatic logon with current username'.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Script Include' not accessible from Client Script. Resolution: Set the 'Client callable' checkbox to true and ensure the script uses the 'AbstractAjaxProcessor' class.
Issue: USB-C port not charging the laptop but data works. Resolution: Perform a 'Static Discharge' by holding the power button for 30 seconds and try a different high-wattage power adapter.

Issue: ServiceNow 'MID Server' status is 'Down'. Resolution: Check the 'MID Server' service on the host machine, verify the 'config.xml' parameters, and check the network connectivity to the SN instance.
Issue: Chrome 'Profile' error every time the browser starts. Resolution: Delete the 'Web Data' file in the Chrome User Data folder or sign out and back into the Chrome Sync profile.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Assignment Group' is empty on a New Incident. Resolution: Check the 'Reference Qualifer' on the Assignment Group field to see if it filters based on the 'Category'.
Issue: Blue Screen 'IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL'. Resolution: This is usually a driver conflict; use 'BlueScreenView' to find the faulty .sys file and roll back that specific hardware driver.
Issue: ServiceNow 'UI Policy' not making a field read-only. Resolution: Check the 'Order' of the UI Policy (higher numbers execute later) and ensure 'On Load' is checked.
Issue: Headset mic is picking up the audio from the speakers. Resolution: Enable 'Acoustic Echo Cancellation' in the sound driver settings and ensure 'Listen to this device' is unchecked.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Knowledge Feedback' not being recorded. Resolution: Check the 'glide.knowman.feedback.enable' system property and verify the 'Live Feed' plugin is active.
Issue: iPhone 'Storage Full' but few photos are saved. Resolution: Clear the 'System Data' by backing up to iCloud and performing a 'Reset All Settings' to clear cached update files.

Issue: ServiceNow 'REST Message' returning '500 Internal Server Error'. Resolution: Inspect the 'HTTP Request' body for JSON syntax errors and check the third-party system's logs for the specific error.
Issue: PDF files opening in 'Microsoft Word' by default. Resolution: Right-click a PDF, select 'Open With > Choose another app', select 'Adobe Reader', and check 'Always use this app'.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Dictionary Entry' cannot be deleted. Resolution: You cannot delete 'Out-of-the-Box' fields; you can only deactivate them or remove them from the form layout.
Issue: Laptop 'Touchscreen' stopped responding. Resolution: Disable and re-enable the 'HID-compliant touch screen' in Device Manager and check for any 'Firmware' updates from the manufacturer.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Service Mapping' showing 'No entry point found'. Resolution: Verify the 'Host name' and 'Port' are correct in the entry point record and check the MID Server's access to that port.
Issue: 'DNS Server Not Responding' on a specific workstation. Resolution: Change the DNS settings to 8.8.8.8 and 8.8.4.4 temporarily to see if the issue is with the local DNS server.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Visual Task Board' cards are not moving. Resolution: Check if the user has 'Write' access to the underlying table (e.g., Incident) for the field used as the 'Lane'.
Issue: BitLocker 'TPM' not detected error. Resolution: Enable 'TPM 2.0' in the BIOS/UEFI settings and ensure 'Secure Boot' is also enabled.
Issue: ServiceNow 'App Engine Studio' missing for a developer. Resolution: Assign the 'sn_app_eng_studio.user' role to the user and ensure the 'App Engine' plugin is installed.

Issue: 'Reboot Pending' message stopping a software installation. Resolution: Delete the 'PendingFileRenameOperations' key in the Windows Registry under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager.
Issue: ServiceNow 'SLA' not attaching to a ticket. Resolution: Check the 'Start Condition' of the SLA Definition and ensure the 'Stop' or 'Pause' conditions are not met simultaneously.
Issue: 'Invalid Partition Table' error during startup. Resolution: Use a Windows Recovery USB, run 'bootrec /fixmbr' and 'bootrec /rebuildbcd' to repair the boot configuration.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Flow Designer' error: 'Maximum execution step count exceeded'. Resolution: Check for infinite loops within the flow logic and increase the 'com.snc.process_flow.max_steps' system property if a large loop is intentional.

Issue: User received a suspicious email with a 'HTML' attachment. Resolution: Isolate the workstation, purge the email from the mail server using PowerShell, and trigger a forced password reset for the user.

Issue: AWS EC2 instance 'Status Check Failed (Instance)'. Resolution: Stop and start the instance to migrate it to a healthy physical host and check the 'System Logs' via the AWS console for kernel panics.

Issue: ServiceNow 'IntegrationHub' connection failure: 'Peer certificate cannot be authenticated'. Resolution: Import the target system's SSL certificate into the ServiceNow 'Certificate Trust Store' and ensure the protocol is HTTPS.

Issue: Azure AD / Entra ID 'Account Lockout' even after password change. Resolution: Check for 'Bad Password' attempts in the Sign-in logs to identify a mobile device or service account still using the old cached credentials.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Performance Analytics' widget shows 'No Data'. Resolution: Verify that the 'Data Collector' job has run successfully and ensure the 'Indicator Source' has the correct date filtering applied.

Issue: Company website is slow due to a suspected DDoS attack. Resolution: Enable 'Under Attack' mode in Cloudflare, block the offending IP ranges at the WAF level, and scale up the origin server resources.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Workspace' showing a blank page for agents. Resolution: Check if the 'UX Page Registry' is configured correctly and verify the user has the 'canvas_user' and workspace-specific roles.
Issue: '403 Forbidden' when uploading a file to an S3 bucket. Resolution: Review the S3 Bucket Policy and IAM permissions to ensure the 's3:PutObject' action is allowed for the user's ARN.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Discovery' failing to find a Linux server. Resolution: Verify the MID Server has SSH access, check if the 'SSH' credential is correct, and ensure the target's firewall allows traffic on port 22.
Issue: Zoom meeting has a 'Waiting for Host' message indefinitely. Resolution: Advise the host to sign in using the 'SSO' option with company credentials rather than a personal email address.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Predictive Intelligence' showing low accuracy. Resolution: Increase the training dataset size to at least 10,000 records and refine the 'Input Fields' to remove noise like timestamps or sys_ids.
Issue: User's laptop has been stolen. Resolution: Remotely wipe the device via Intune/Jamf, disable the user's AD account, and revoke all active OAuth tokens for corporate applications.
Issue: ServiceNow 'REST API' Explorer returning '415 Unsupported Media Type'. Resolution: Ensure the 'Content-Type' header is set to 'application/json' in the request headers.

Issue: Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) showing 'No resources available'. Resolution: Check the 'Host Pool' to see if session hosts are available and ensure the 'Drain Mode' is turned off on at least one server.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Dictionary Override' not working on a child table. Resolution: Ensure the 'Override display value' or 'Override mandatory' checkbox is selected on the specific child table record.

Issue: MFA prompt not appearing on the user's 'Authenticator' app. Resolution: Check if the user has an active internet connection and ask them to use the 'One-time password code' method or re-register the app.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Guided Tour' not starting for new users. Resolution: Verify the 'Autostart' condition in the tour configuration and ensure the user is landing on the exact URL specified.
Issue: SQL Server 'Transaction Log' is full. Resolution: Perform a transaction log backup or change the recovery model to 'Simple' if point-in-time recovery is not required for that database.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Variable Validation' regex not working. Resolution: Test the regex pattern in a JavaScript sandbox and ensure the 'Validation Script' is linked to the correct variable.

Issue: 'Your organization's data cannot be pasted here' error in Outlook mobile. Resolution: This is an Intune App Protection Policy; check the 'Restrict cut, copy, and paste' setting in the Endpoint Manager console.

Issue: ServiceNow 'Service Mapping' discovery is stuck on 'In Progress'. Resolution: Restart the MID Server service and check for 'Horizontal Discovery' patterns that might be hanging on a specific step.

Issue: GitHub 'Push' rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey)'. Resolution: Run 'ssh-add' to add the private key to the agent and ensure the public key is added to the GitHub 'SSH and GPG keys' settings.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Instance' is running slow for all users. Resolution: Check the 'Transaction Logs' for long-running queries and review the 'Semaphores' page to see if nodes are hitting capacity.

Issue: User cannot open encrypted 'WinZip' files. Resolution: Ensure the user has the correct decryption password and check if the 'AES-256' encryption standard is supported by their version of WinZip.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Catalog Client Script' failing in the mobile app. Resolution: Rewrite the script to use 'g_form' methods that are compatible with the mobile API and set UI Type to 'All'.
Issue: 'No healthy upstream' error on a web application. Resolution: Check the health check settings on the Load Balancer and ensure the backend service is listening on the correct port.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Attachment' size limit exceeded. Resolution: Adjust the 'com.glide.attachment.max_size' system property to the desired limit (in MB).
Issue: Printer 'Default Gateway' is not reachable. Resolution: Assign a static IP address to the printer and ensure the Subnet Mask and Gateway match the local network configuration.
Issue: ServiceNow 'User Criteria' not applying to a Knowledge Base. Resolution: Check if 'Enable User Criteria' property is true and verify the 'Can Read' list on the KB record.
Issue: 'Disk Quota' exceeded for a user on a Linux file server. Resolution: Increase the user's quota using the 'edquota' command or identify and remove large unnecessary files.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Report' is taking too long to load. Resolution: Add more filters to reduce the result set and consider creating a 'Database View' if the report joins multiple large tables.
Issue: Windows 'Firewall' blocking a specific application. Resolution: Create an 'Inbound Rule' in Advanced Security settings to allow the specific .exe file or port number.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Import Set' showing 'Staging' status indefinitely. Resolution: Check the 'Scheduled Import' job and ensure the 'Import Set Transformer' is not waiting for a busy MID Server.
Issue: 'Access Key' expired for an AWS IAM user. Resolution: Generate a new Access Key/Secret Key pair in the IAM console and update the local '.aws/credentials' file.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Translation' missing for a field label. Resolution: Add the translated string to the 'sys_documentation' table for the specific language code (e.g., 'fr' for French).
Issue: Blue Screen 'KMODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED'. Resolution: Disable 'Fast Startup' in Power Options and update the network or Wi-Fi drivers which often cause this error.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Email Layout' is broken in Outlook. Resolution: Use inline CSS styles for the email template and avoid using complex 'div' structures that Outlook's rendering engine rejects.

Issue: 'Target Principal Name is Incorrect' when connecting to a SQL Server. Resolution: This is a Kerberos SPN issue; verify the Service Principal Name is registered correctly for the SQL service account.
Issue: ServiceNow 'UX Macroponent' not rendering in UI Builder. Resolution: Check for console errors in the browser and ensure all required 'Data Brokers' are configured with the correct inputs.
Issue: User's 'Bitlocker' key is not in Active Directory. Resolution: Check the 'Azure AD' device record or the 'ServiceNow CMDB' if keys are backed up there; otherwise, a drive reformat is required.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Order Guide' not cascading variables. Resolution: Ensure the 'Cascade Variables' checkbox is checked on the Order Guide record and the variable names match across items.
Issue: '504 Gateway Timeout' during a large file download. Resolution: Increase the 'Keep-Alive' and 'Proxy Timeout' settings on the Nginx or Apache reverse proxy.

Issue: ServiceNow 'App Customization' not appearing in the 'App Picker'. Resolution: Ensure the user has the 'source_control' or 'admin' role and that the application is in the 'Global' or correct scope.
Issue: Microphone volume is too low on a 'Dell' laptop. Resolution: Open 'Waves MaxxAudio Pro' utility and turn up the 'Microphone' enhancement settings.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Embedded Help' not showing for a specific role. Resolution: Check the 'Role' field on the Embedded Help record and verify the 'Page' path matches the current UI.
Issue: Kubernetes pod stuck in 'CrashLoopBackOff'. Resolution: Run 'kubectl logs [pod_name]' to see the application error and check the 'readinessProbe' configuration.
Issue: ServiceNow 'UI Page' showing raw HTML code. Resolution: Ensure the 'Processing Script' and 'HTML' fields are correctly using Jelly or AngularJS syntax and tags are closed.
Issue: 'Duplicate IP Address' detected on the network. Resolution: Locate the physical device using the MAC address in the switch ARP table and change its IP to 'DHCP'.
Issue: ServiceNow 'Notification' sent to a user but not received. Resolution: Check if the user has 'Unsubscribed' from that notification category in their 'Notification Preferences'.
